purpose: Teach: ごちそう/居眠り/ばったり/噴水/観賞/トランペット/ガッカリ/折りたたみ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お誕生日に、絶対、ごちそう、絶対、作ってあげるね
lines.en: Sho, I really mean it — I'm going to make you an amazing birthday feast, no matter what.
lines.style: Warm, generous opening. Soft emphasis on the promise. Leans forward slightly. Steady eye contact, like she's making a vow she absolutely intends to keep.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、絵本、絶対、読みながら、絶対、居眠り、絶対、しちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really did — I fell asleep while you were reading me picture books.
lines.style: Small, rueful laugh under the words. Self-conscious admission. Gentle and matter-of-fact, like he's confessing something minor but true. A hint of sheepishness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、街角で、絶対、ばったり、絶対、お母さんに、絶対、会ったわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, something funny happened — I ran into your mom at the corner the other day.
lines.style: Conversational, warm recollection. Slight lift at 「corner」like she's painting a small scene. Unhurried. A touch of affection in the detail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園の、本気で、絶対、噴水、絶対、ぼく、絶対、メイ姉さんと、絶対、見たいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to — see the fountain at the park with you sometime.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. A small, hopeful lilt at the end. Not demanding, just genuinely wishing. The kind of simple request a six-year-old makes when he's thought about it carefully.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お花の、絶対、観賞、絶対、お庭で、絶対、楽しんでるわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, you know what I've been doing? Spending time in the garden just enjoying the flowers.
lines.style: Soft, unhurried. Gentle pride in the small pleasure. No rush to the words. A quiet invitation to imagine her doing this calm thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、メイ姉さんに、絶対、トランペット、絶対、聴かせたいよ
lines.en: I really want to play my trumpet for you sometime, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Direct, eager but not loud. A touch of vulnerability beneath the enthusiasm—he's offering something he cares about. Slight upward lift on 「trumpet」.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 試合で、本気で、絶対、負けて、絶対、ガッカリ、絶対、しても、絶対、次があるわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Even if you lose a match and feel disappointed, Sho, there's always a next time.
lines.style: Steady, grounded reassurance. Not cheerful, not dismissive. Spoken like a fact she knows from experience. Gentle firmness. A hand on his shoulder in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、折りたたみ、絶対、椅子、絶対、ピクニックで、絶対、使うんだよね
lines.en: Right, Mei-sis uses the folding chair for picnics, doesn't she?
lines.style: Bright recognition. A small smile in the voice. He's piecing something together about her—her habits, her world. Animated but genuine, not performing.
